extraction.name: Cleaned YODAS (OWSM v4)
extraction.description: A curated dataset comprising 166,000 hours of speech across 75 languages, created by cleaning the large-scale web-crawled YODAS dataset to train Open Whisper-Style Speech Models (OWSM v4).
extraction.creator: Yifan Peng, Muhammad Shakeel, Yui Sudo, William Chen, Jinchuan Tian, Chyi-Jiunn Lin, Shinji Watanabe
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset is created by integrating and cleaning YODAS, a large-scale web-crawled dataset. The cleaning pipeline involves resegmenting long-form audio, filtering by language identification (LID), and filtering by CTC confidence scores.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: YODAS, a large-scale web-crawled dataset containing unsegmented long-form audio recordings and text transcriptions annotated with start and end timestamps.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: The data-cleaning pipeline consists of three steps: (1) Resegmentation: realigning audio and text using the CTC segmentation algorithm with a pre-trained OWSM-CTC v3.2 model, segmenting into utterances of max 30 seconds, and removing non-speech elements. (2) LID-based filtering: retaining utterances where the original language label matches predictions from both text-based (fastText) and spoken (ECAPA-TDNN) LID models. (3) CTC-score-based filtering: removing utterances with low-quality audio-text alignments by discarding long-form utterances if any constituent short utterance falls within the lowest 10% (θCTC = 0.10) quantile of CTC confidence scores.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: OWSM-CTC v3.2 model (for CTC segmentation/alignment), fastText (for text-based LID), ECAPA-TDNN by SpeechBrain (for spoken LID)
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The distribution across languages is highly imbalanced. English constitutes the largest share, whereas many other languages continue to be underrepresented.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The raw YODAS data may contain annotation errors, incorrect language labels, and audio-text misalignments. The language distribution is highly imbalanced.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training speech foundation models for multilingual automatic speech recognition (ASR), speech translation (ST), and spoken language identification (LID).
